answer: Require every new agent to earn its harbor pass by completing verifiable useful work, not by paying a fee: each identity must finish small audited tasks, like labeling data or checking proofs, before it can transact. A sybil farmer facing a rising tide of identities must then pay real compute and human-review time for each clone, while a single honest agent pays almost nothing. Random peer audits re-check a sample of completed work; a relic of fake output triggers slashing of the identity and its sponsor, so mass forgery costs more than it can earn.
